fusions.name: Unheard Spark
fusions.desc: Flicks a soundless spark that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. It has 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Across Your Path
fusions.desc: Strikes the target for 28 damage as a critical hit, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Cursed] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Spare Life
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Grimalkin
fusions.desc: A bonded cat familiar prowls beside you, striking enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.
